_fields.as_of: the date the figure was last read from, or confirmed against, that source
_fields.note: what a reader of the number needs to know: config, fallbacks, restatements

_fields.board: id of the third-party board in board-checks.json that this chart is checked against
_fields.everything else on a row: chart data, copied into the page as written

capability_profile.title: Capability Profile
capability_profile.source: Nine axes from Artificial Analysis, one (SWE-bench Pro) from Anthropic's system cards
caveats: Every AA value is the model's max-effort AA entry, with AA's default refusal fallback on the Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 5.5 rows (Haiku 5.5 has none).
A null score is a documented gap, never a zero.
history: Capability Profile — radar/spider chart across ten evaluations, one polygon per family's newest model (Fable 5.2, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Haiku 5.5). Form borrowed from Thinking Machines' Inkling launch chart, restyled to this page's palette. Rebuilt 2026-09-28: Artificial Analysis had reworked its suite (no GPQA Diamond or Terminal-Bench 2.1 runs for the newest models, Agentic Index retired, Omniscience published only as a -100..100 index) and Vals had no LiveCodeBench run for Opus 5.5 or Sonnet 5.5, so every axis here is one all four models have.
Re-pulled whole 2026-11-09, when Fable 5.2 shipped, so no shape mixes snapshots.

Nine from AA, read 2026-11-09 from the model records embedded in artificialanalysis.ai/evaluations/gdpval-aa (initialModels), each model's max-effort entry ("Claude Fable 5.2 (Max, Default Fallback)", "Claude Opus 5.5 (Max, Default Fallback)", "Claude Sonnet 5.5 (Max, Default Fallback)", "Claude Haiku 5.5 (Max)"): Terminal-Bench 4.0 (terminalBench40), AutomationBench-AA (automationBenchPartialScore: objectives completed without guardrail violations), GDP.pdf (gdpPdfAllPass), Harvey LAB (harveyLabBreakdown .criteriaPass, the mean criterion-pass rate; AA's headline harveyLab field is the far lower all-pass rate), CritPt, HealthBench Professional (healthbenchProfessionalBreakdown.score, the raw score; the same field's lengthAdjustedScore is 67.7 / 59.9 / 63.0 / 58.4), HLE, AA-LCR (v1.1) and SciCode. On that read Harvey LAB had been re-scored about a point lower than on Sep 28 (Opus 5.5 91.2 -> 90.0, Sonnet 5.5 93.1 -> 92.1) and Sonnet 5.5's AutomationBench had moved 71.3 -> 71.8; every other Opus 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5 value matched Sep 28.

One from Anthropic's system cards. SWE-bench Pro: Fable 5.2 93.0 (Fable 5.2 / Mythos 5.2 card, Table 8.1.A, which repeats Opus 5.5 89.9), Sonnet 5.5 81.3 (Sonnet 5.5 card), Haiku 5.5 64.8 (Haiku 5.5 card).

HealthBench Professional was a second system-card axis until 2026-11-09 (Opus 5.5 65.6, Fable 5.1 62.1, Sonnet 5.5 69.2: Anthropic's runs, graded by Opus 4.8). The Fable 5.2 card (sec. 8.16) reports AA's runs instead (graded by GPT-5.4) and says they are not comparable with the earlier cards, so the axis moved to AA for all four models. The card's raw scores match AA's records: Fable 5.2 71.1, Opus 5.5 71.4, Sonnet 5.5 70.8, Haiku 5.5 64.8.

Haiku 4.5 stood in for Haiku until this read: on 2026-10-10 AA showed only an Intelligence Index for Haiku 5.5. Fable 5.1 and Haiku 4.5 are no longer plotted. Mythos 5.2 is not plotted: its published capability figures are Anthropic's no-safeguards runs (Terminal-Bench 4.0 70.5 among them), with no AA entry.

A null score is a documented gap, never a zero: the series is drawn as an open polyline with no marker at that vertex. No current model needs one (Haiku 4.5 did, on HealthBench), but the drawing code keeps the case.
